industries_of_interest: Social Impact: Nonprofits, Education, Civic Tech
application.communication_style: Direct and structured with clear action items

goals.mobility: Skill Development, Promotion or Role Advancement
goals.novelty: Learning from Failure, Exposure to New Perspectives

application.why_mmc: I grew up watching my parents work multiple jobs without ever finding a career that fulfilled them. I want something different and I need someone who has walked this path to show me it is possible. MMC feels like the community I never had access to growing up.
application.previous_mentoring: I had an informal mentor in college — a professor who encouraged me to apply for internships I did not think I was qualified for. That experience changed my trajectory entirely.
application.expectations: I want to build a relationship with someone who will be honest with me about where I need to grow, help me navigate the unwritten rules of the tech industry, and hold me accountable to my goals.
application.additional_context: I am currently working full time while completing an online certification in cloud computing. Time management is my biggest challenge right now.
application.career_vision: In five years I want to be a senior software engineer at a company whose mission I genuinely believe in — ideally one using technology to solve education or climate challenges. In ten years I hope to be leading a team and mentoring others the way I hope to be mentored now.
application.excited_about: AI-assisted developer tools and how they are changing what it means to be an early career engineer. Also deeply interested in civic tech and how software can improve government services.
application.critical_skills: System design, technical communication, learning how to scope and estimate work accurately, and becoming more confident presenting my ideas in large group settings.
application.anticipated_challenges: Imposter syndrome is real for me. I often second-guess whether my ideas are worth sharing. I also worry about the gap between my current skills and what senior roles require.
application.success_definition: Success means doing work that matters, being compensated fairly for it, and having enough flexibility to show up fully for the people I love. It is not just a title.
application.career_role_model: Kimberly Bryant, founder of Black Girls CODE. She built something from nothing because the thing she needed did not exist. That resonates deeply with me.
application.ideal_environment: Collaborative, psychologically safe, and mission-driven. I want to work somewhere that celebrates curiosity and does not punish mistakes made in good faith.
application.proud_accomplishment: Ship a product that a first-generation student somewhere uses to get a job they never thought was possible for someone like them.
